title: ResearchOS Run
description: One round of the hypothesis cycle: what was spent and how much of it needed a human. This ledger is a measuring instrument, not a gate: its purpose is to make the automation rate computable (human_interventions per round) and to stop the failure recorded in contributions/2026-10-21_svm_results.md, where the wall clock had to be replaced by a proxy because nobody had recorded when a session started. See docs/2026-10-21_hypothesis-cycle-automation.md section 6.

ended_at.description: Absent while the round is still running

base_commit.description: Commit the round started from (git rev-parse HEAD)

human_interventions.description: Number of times a human made a decision this round: chose the topic, approved a ledger insert, resolved a conflict, stopped the loop. The automation rate is 1 - interventions/decisions.

metrics.description: Free-form measured numbers: tokens, seconds, self_support_rate, adjudication_agreement, refutations_found.
